import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/aiohttp')
from aiohttp.http_parser import HttpRequestParserPy
from aiohttp.base_protocol import BaseProtocol
from unittest import mock
protocol = mock.create_autospec(BaseProtocol, spec_set=True, instance=True)
parser = HttpRequestParserPy(protocol, mock.Mock(), 2**16)
text = b"GET /test HTTP/1.1\r\ntransfer-encoding: chunked123\r\n\r\n"
try:
    parser.feed_data(text)
    print("No exception")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Exception: {e}")

import asyncio
from unittest import mock
from aiohttp.http_parser import HttpRequestParserPy
from aiohttp.base_protocol import BaseProtocol

protocol = mock.create_autospec(BaseProtocol, spec_set=True, instance=True)
loop = asyncio.new_event_loop()
parser = HttpRequestParserPy(protocol, loop, 2**16)
text = b"GET /test HTTP/1.1\r\ntransfer-encoding: chunked123\r\n\r\n"
try:
    parser.feed_data(text)
    print("No exception")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Exception: {e}")

arguments.summary: Fixed transfer encoding handling in aiohttp's Python HTTP parser to match spec: correctly parse TE header with commas, require 'chunked' token to be last, reject tokens starting with 'chunked' but not equal, ignore other unknown tokens.
